Grain Policy
grain RATES & discounts - effective 09/09/2026
Please reach us at office@prairieagcommodities.com or 319-865-1450 if you have specific questions.
Drying Rates for Corn
Drying and shrink will apply to all corn SOLD or placed on Warehouse Receipt, Price Later Contract. Corn that is Priced will be dried to 15% moisture. Each load will stand on its own.
1.75 cent each .5% or fraction above 14.0%
We will use a shrink factor on corn of 1.35%
Storage Rates
Corn
Minimum Charge: 22 cents per bushel for 90 days
After Minimum: $.0013 per bushel per day thereafter
Beans
Minimum Charge: 24 cents per bushel for 90 days
After Minimum: $.0015 per bushel per day thereafter
Price Later Contract
Corn
Service Charge and Drying Rates: 22 cents per bushel for 90 days
Will be dried to 14% $.0013 per bushel per day thereafter
Beans
Service Charge and Drying Rates: 24 cents per bushel for 90 days
$.0015 per bushel per day thereafter
Contract good for one year and can be renewed at the service charge and drying rate of the current year. Producer receives Prairie Ag Commodities price at the time of pricing and can be sold in any bushel amount. Subject to the current discounts and policies established at Prairie Ag Commodities.
Corn Discounts
Test Weight: Below 54# to 50# 1 cent per pound or fraction
Below 50# 2 cents per pound or fraction
Damage: 5.1% - 10.0% 2 cents each 1.0% or fraction above
10.1% - 15.0% 3 cents each 1.0% or fraction above
Above 15.0% 4 cents each 1.0% or fraction above
Foreign Materials: 3.1% - 10.0% 2 cents each 1.0% or fraction above
Above 10.0% 3 cents each 1.0% or fraction above and subject to rejection
Aflatoxin: Subject to rejection
Musty: 10 cents per bushel
Sour: 10 cents per bushel
Heating/Hot: 10 cents per bushel
Weevily: 10 cents per bushel
COFO: 10 cents per bushel and subject to rejection
Bean Discounts
Test Weight: Below 54# to 52# 1 cent per pound or fraction
Below 52# 2 cents per pound or fraction
Moisture: 13.1% - 17.0% 12 cents each .5% or fraction
Above 17.0% 24 cents each .5% or fraction and
Subject to rejection
Foreign Materials: In excess of 1% Shall be deducted from weight
Damage: 2.1% - 10.0% 2 cents each 1.0% or fraction
Above 10.0% Subject to rejection
Musty: 10 cents per bushel
Sour: 10 cents per bushel
Heating/Hot: 10 cents per bushel
HARVEST 2026-2027
We will hold grain in an open position for 15 days. After 15 days, grain will be put in storage, using the average deposit date for the storage date. Grain brought in after 4:00 p.m. will be on next day’s business.
Direct shipped grain is subject to the respective terminal discounts. All discounts listed are subject to change without notice.
All spot priced grain will be priced using Prairie Ag Commodities' closing price on the date delivered (weekend deliveries after 4:00 pm Friday will use Monday's closing price.)
